name: github
description: Wox plugin for GitHub issues and notifications

scripts.build: pnpm clean && ncc build src/index.ts -o dist && babel dist --out-dir dist && node -e "const{cpSync}=require('fs');cpSync('images','dist/images',{recursive:true});cpSync('plugin.json','dist/plugin.json');cpSync('templates','dist/templates',{recursive:true})"
scripts.package: pnpm build && cd dist && zip -r ../wox.plugin.github.wox *.js *.json images templates
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch images --watch plugin.json --watch templates --ext json,ts,js,mjs,png,html --exec pnpm run build
scripts.clean: node -e "var { rmSync, existsSync } = require('fs'), path = require('path'); ['./dist'].forEach(fPath => {if (existsSync(path.join(__dirname, fPath))) rmSync(path.join(__dirname, fPath), { recursive: true, force: true })}); process.exit(0);"
